Proposal A: add a configuration setting system.theme.message_dismiss and read it in the preprocess function.

function system_preprocess_status_messages(&$variables) {
  $variables['dismissible'] = \Drupal::config('system.theme')->get('message_dismiss');
}

This keeps the markup the same and lets sites turn the behaviour off. It needs an update path and a config schema entry.
